notes.title: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU Patch 1.5 notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/bc522b46990be0fb7c3fcba6bfef7976bc3231a8.png[/img]
Today we are launching Patch 1.5 for Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU. Surgent Studios have been working hard to improve the ZAU experience based on your invaluable player feedback and suggestions which they’ve followed closely ever since launch.

In the 1.5 update, we’re thrilled to introduce the following exciting updates:

[u][b]Patch Notes
[/b][/u]
[list][*] Added three new [b]Hard Spirit Trials[/b] to each of the Spirit Trials locations, unlockable when the player has completed the normal Spirit Trials. Players who complete all new Hard Spirit Trials will receive the coveted Big Head Mode toggle.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/5c1b725d28d3aa1883475887da63785b56bad65c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/736c246056d5cb89651aa41065033fd9f6b97f18.gif[/img]

[list][*] Improved lock-in encounters in 9 different areas, adjusting enemy configuration to make combat feel more balanced and enjoyable.
[*] PlayStation 5 controllers can now be connected to a PC via Bluetooth (Please note PlayStation 4 controllers still must be connected via USB)
[*] Other minor fixes[/list]
Once again, thank you for your consistent feedback and support. It is an extremely useful resource for us to keep improving our game, making it all the better for you to play! 

If you encounter any issues during your gameplay, please reach out and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2316580/discussions/1/][u][b][u][b]let us know here[/b][/u][/b][/u][/url].

notes.title: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU Patch 1.4 notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/3a283307b9f750d87d06d8773aa4e0bd375bf104.png[/img]
Today we are launching [b]Patch 1.4[/b] for Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU. Since we launched Zau back in April of this year, the community have provided us with plenty of excellent feedback and suggestions, which the team at Surgent Studios have acted upon to give you an even better experience in your travels across the lands of Kenzera.

We’re pleased to announce that, thanks to your ongoing support, we’ve made the following updates and fixes:

[h3][b][u]Patch Notes[/u][/b][/h3]

In the 1.4 patch, we are bringing you important new ability upgrades to Zau’s arsenal, new quality of life improvements for traversal, rebalances to the lower difficulties of the game along with other miscellaneous fixes and improvements.


[list][*] Improved the Zawadi’s Hook ability. In addition to its use in traversal, Zawadi’s Hook can now also be used in combat. Deploying the Hook while wearing the Mask of the Sun will pull Zau to the targeted enemy. With the Mask of the Moon, the enemy will be pulled to Zau.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/21144847e7302411cb506eabc0226776ae229fa0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/328c68143305ca22fe3457a294bfb11dcd5cf64d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/298e04b156c8f610ef040d43375aae74327177cd.gif[/img]

[list][*] Added 18 fast travel points for a grand total of 32 in the whole game, making 100% completion smoother and more efficient[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/9d3b457713bb3ce08a5ed72d98da7c9eff22a4c0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/07aead7647a185d98d0d8efa12f22e68bd40c8ae.gif[/img]

[list][*] Tuned shielded enemies on the lowest and second-lowest difficulties. Shielded enemies can now be pushed back or knocked upwards, making them easier to defeat[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/59f5f373db0c89cbecc58c725a0e25167121af37.gif[/img]

[list][*] Improved controller glyph support for Nintendo Switch Pro controller, DualSense wireless controller, and Xbox wireless controller

- Added DualSense haptics and improved controller haptics on all platforms

[*] Improved controller haptics on all platforms
[*] Improved Story mode platforms to make them more consistent with other difficulty levels
[*] Other minor improvements[/list]
Once again, thank you for your consistent feedback and support. It is an extremely useful resource for us to keep improving our game, making it all the better for you to play! 

If you encounter any issues during your gameplay, please reach out and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2316580/discussions/1/][u][b][u][b]let us know here[/b][/u][/b][/u][/url].

notes.title: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU Patch 1.3 notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/0130501084fa095fd9fdf7da6b361509c9bd62e8.jpg[/img]
Today we are launching patch 1.3 for Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU. We're calling it the [b]"Most Requested Updates"[/b] patch because it offers some big changes that come directly from community requests and feedback! 

Since ZAU’s launch in April, we’ve received tons of useful feedback and vital bug reporting from our community, which helps us bring you an even better experience in your travels across the lands of Kenzera.

We’re pleased to announce that, thanks to your ongoing support, we’ve made the following updates and fixes:

[h3][b][u]Patch Notes[/u][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added [b]two new difficulty levels[/b] in addition to Relaxed, Balanced, and Challenging. 
[/list][olist]
[*] “Story” is even more forgiving than “Relaxed” in combat, providing further support on traversal and restoring full health at each checkpoint upon death. 
[*] “Brutal” is a step beyond “Challenging” and is tailored for those who want to get a strong sense of the enormity of Zau’s task. “Brutal” emphasises dashing, using skills and abilities effectively, and remembering enemy attack patterns[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/dccfbd94e3470038830b2e4b04a92663bddbe604.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Adjusted hazards like the [b]insta-kill spikes[/b], diminishing collision slightly so they feel more fun and fair
[*] Added the [b]option to skip chase sequences[/b] after a designated number of attempts determined by the player’s selected difficulty level.
[*] Improved the [b]map’s fog of war[/b], making it easier for collectors to identify areas where content may have been missed[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/dfd2b8771f145da9a695ec09e675dc1c0c2fc159.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which players weren’t immediately aware of ZAU’s difficulty selection. Players will now be asked to choose their difficulty level upon starting a new game.
[*] Tied players’ chosen difficulty to their save slot for those who play on multiple saves or who share the game with others[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/79aad9cce14a2fea3295287a288107f07cb097bf.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added hints, tips and reminders to the pause menu[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/4982871cae3df13883a614386ff2e0a57407cada.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a pop-up tutorial for the Kikiyaon Heart encounter[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/fb6a200d4f9b3f9b6bb6a39c8c5ae6853ccf2d09.gif[/img]
[h3][u][b]Other Fixes[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue in which “I Am the Sun” achievement was not awarded if enemies were killed by Ignite from Supernova
[*] Fixed an issue in which Zau became stuck in pre-charge animation after the dash, double jump, and charge combo
[*] Fixed an issue in which players could not use Bamba’s Stone on GaGorib while he performs Body Slam
[*] Fixed issue in which seize expended dash and double jump charges
[*] Other minor fixes[/list]
[h3][u][b]Chase Sequences Gameplay changes[/b][/u]
[/h3]
You’ve consistently given us feedback saying you wished there was an option to skip the chase sequences in ZAU, so we added it! Depending on the difficulty level you’ve selected, a Yumboe will appear after a certain number of attempts and let you skip if you’re struggling. The criteria for when the Yumboe will appear are:[list]
[*] Story: The player always has the option
[*] Relaxed: Will appear after 3 deaths in total
[*] Balanced: Will appear after 5 deaths in total
[*] Challenging: Will appear after 10 deaths in total
[*] Brutal: The player never has the option[/list]
A Yumboe will remain in place once it has appeared, so if you are playing on Story difficulty and then switch to Brutal difficulty, it'll still be there for you.

It’s worth noting that deaths are shared between all parts of the chase, so if you die 3 times in the first part of a chase and 2 times in the second part of a chase, the Yumboe will appear for Balanced difficulty players.

If the player changes difficulty, the game doesn’t reset how many times the player has died.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/b3826869689aed8a6a9e506ca8153046e22cb702.gif[/img]

Once again, thank you for your consistent feedback and support. It is an extremely useful resource for us to keep improving our game, making it all the better for you to play! 

If you encounter any issues during your gameplay, please reach out and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2316580/discussions/1/][u][b][u][b]let us know here[/b][/u][/b][/u][/url].

Are you looking for a community to discuss Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU? [url=https://discord.gg/Surgent][u][b]Join the official Surgent Studios Discord server[/b][/u][/url], where we have a dedicated section for the game for fans to discuss tricks & tips, share fan art and gameplay clips! 

[url=https://discord.gg/Surgent][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/300daef05225bcf76b794c15b4cf678425008e15.gif[/img][/url]

Did you enjoy your time in Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU? [b]Please consider leaving us a Steam review![/b] Your review can really help us out by letting other Steam users know your thoughts on the game as well as providing us great feedback that we can use to potentially make the game even better!

notes.title: Play the new Tales of Kenzera: ZAU demo now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/c8cf8140e09b1f9ede698f0819b801aedb7500ef.png[/img]
It’s been an electrifying couple of months since the release of Tales of Kenzera: ZAU and if you haven’t already tried embracing your warrior shaman, we have good news for you! The team at Surgent Studios has been hard at work creating an updated trial offering of Tales of Kenzera: ZAU in the [b]brand-new playable demo out today on Steam[/b], including all the quality-of-life improvements and fixes that have been added since the game launched earlier this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/8d29704c3efd4b558fd1f8e7312a0dc0ae7b2a45.gif[/img]

The demo will give you a peek into the early moments of ZAU, offering a taste of its fleet-footed and fast-paced combat and traversal and a first look at the emotional story as it begins to unfold. Defeat marauding enemies like the Roho ya Rungu and Roho ya Mtupaji, and beware of the cunning, explosive Tokoloshe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/63999a960ea3a8c42d7c35e2d239c999cd1d32c8.gif[/img]

Within the pre-defined demo area, eagle-eyed players will also discover hidden Echoes, which will lend a crucial hint to the full game’s narrative framing.

Your time in Kenzera begins as you, a young warrior-shaman, arrive in the sanctuary Patakatifu and call upon Kalunga, the God of Death, to strike up a very unusual bargain. As you begin the journey to fulfill your end of the deal, you will learn to wield two powerful masks imbued with the cosmic power of the sun and the moon in a beautiful and chaotic dance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/9e819528838b5db7ff63825159cee5ef6be79357.gif[/img]

Players who wish to see more of the lands of Kenzera after completing the demo can carry on their progress into the full game when they purchase it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/c43d8c356b521b14f859bacb4e97811a785b01b2.gif[/img]

Tales of Kenzera: ZAU is also [b][u][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xQbaKSvjWMU]Verified on Steam Deck[/url][/u][/b], allowing players to roam the lands of Kenzera while on the go too!

And in that same spirit of making Tales of Kenzera: ZAU as accessible as possible to everyone, players can still get a copy of the full game with a 25% discount across multiple platforms!

[list][*]Steam: June 13 - July 11[/list]
If you haven’t already, you can learn more and get Tales of Kenzera: ZAU [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316580/Tales_of_Kenzera_ZAU/][u]here[/u][/url].

notes.title: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU Patch 1.1 notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/259f60c250314ae216e16787940fdbe0097ec6f0.png[/img]

Today we are bringing you the very first patch for Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU. Since launch last month, we have received incredible support from our community with love and praise for our debut game!

We’ve also been given amazing feedback on the game as well as vital bug reporting which we have now acted upon to bring you an even better experience in your travels across the lands of Kenzera.

We’re pleased to inform you that thanks to your ongoing support, we’ve managed to track down and resolve the below issues:

[u][b]Patch notes
[/b][/u][list]
[*] Fixed issue in which players could become stuck beneath the Ikakaramba lift. If this has already happened to you, walk away and then reapproach the lift.
[*] Fixed issue in which movement interrupted by opening the map and other submenus would not continue after closing the map and submenus.
[*] Fixed camera issue near the start of the Kikiyaon encounter.
[*] Fixed issue in which rapidly closing the prompt that appears after death in a Spirit Trial would make the trial unusable.
[*] Fixed issue in which the player could become stuck under the floor when fast travelling.
[*] Fixed issue in which players could perform Seize with no valid enemies nearby.
[*] Fixed instances in which doors with pushable blocks pressed against them may fail to open.
[*] Fixed issue with the Ikakaramba lift in which combat music wouldn't stop correctly.
[*] Fixed issue in which the door leading out of the mines in Highlands would remain locked.
[*] Fixed issue in which players weren't able to shoot diagonally using some controller setups.
[*] Fixed issue in which Adze would continue certain attacks while frozen by Bamba's Stone.
[*] Fixed instances in which some drop-through platforms weren’t marked in the same way as others.
[*] Improvements made to Tshukudu's Might input resolving issues in which it failed to activate if many inputs were registered in the same frame.
[*] Improvements made to Tshukudu's Might gates increasing leniency with the angle of approach for greater ease of use.
[*] Improvements made to the lava chase for slightly greater leniency.
[*] Improvements made to combat balancing.
[*] Improvements made to wall jumping to better support the ability to change direction before fully making contact with the wall.
[*] Improvements made to Kabili's Wings controls for greater responsiveness and quicker activation. Additional amends made to speed changes between ascent and descent to increase ease of manoeuvrability. Leaving Kabili's Wings in updraft volumes will not result in immediate freefall.
[*] Fixed issue in which trials could still be considered incomplete after obtaining their corresponding trinket. For existing players, the issue should be fixed after reloading their most recent save file.
[/list]
Thank you all once again for your consistent feedback and support. It is an extremely useful resource for us to keep improving our game to make it all the better for you to play! 

If you encounter any issues during your gameplay, please reach out and let us know [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2316580/discussions/1/][u][b]here[/b][/u][/url].

Looking for a community to discuss Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU? Come join the official [url=https://discord.gg/surgent][u][b]Surgent Studios Discord server[/b][/u][/url], where we have a dedicated section for the game for fans to discuss, share tricks and tips, share fan art and gameplay clips! 

Did you enjoy your time in Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU? [b]Please consider leaving us a Steam review![/b] Your review can really help us out by letting other Steam users know your thoughts on the game as well as providing us great feedback that we can use to potentially make the game even better!

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS NOW AVAILABLE IN SWAHILI
notes.content:
Full immersion for the completionists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/9bd7ad219c084911ca73a7c778d7f631f73b8085.jpg[/img]

When we first announced the news that Tales of Kenzera: ZAU is playable in both English and Swahili voiceover, we were thrilled see so many of you as excited about it as we are!

It was a huge priority for us and, once we found out we could make it work, we threw ourselves wholeheartedly into finding a brilliant Swahili-speaking cast.

We're already hearing from a surprising number of players who are doing a full run of ZAU in Swahili followed by a second run in English, or vice versa. That curiosity and enthusiasm for this beautiful language is really gratifying to see. 

Due to a quirk in the system, however, we discovered that we wouldn't be able to present any of the achievements in Swahili. They're all translated and ready to go, but we couldn't figure out how to get them to those of you wanted the full Swahili experience.

So, we found a workaround.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/0c0cba94c9c6da4d2c6e4a44b0d2719c26dd4a4f.png[/img]

The above is just a small selection of the achievements, of course. [url=https://www.ea.com/en-gb/games/tales-of-kenzera/zau/achievements]You can find all of them on our game's page here.[/url] [b]Fair warning: the completionists among you may wish to avoid spoilers by not visiting this page until you're ready. Something to bookmark for later.
[/b]
As always, you have all our gratitude for your generous support. We hope you're enjoying ZAU, no matter which language you went with in the end.

- The Surgent Team

notes.title: Tips and Tricks to get you safely across the lands of Kenzera
notes.content:
If you’ve found yourself travelling across the harsh and unforgiving lands of Kenzera and suffering its consequences more often than not, we’ve got some top tier tips ready for you! Settle down at the Yumboe camp and read on as we offer you some sage advice on how to safely assist Zau on his quest. If you haven't started your quest just yet, remember that Tales of Kenzera: ZAU is out now for 19.99 or as part of PlayStation Plus extra. Now, let's get started,

[h2]Reflections.[/h2]

At the start of the game, Zau isn’t quite at his full potential, with a limited amount of HP. As Zau explores Kenzera, he can find large awe-inspiring Baobab trees, which he can use as a point of reflection. 

Upon sitting down underneath these and reflecting on his memories, Zau will be rewarded with an additional segment on his health bar, making him more resilient to ending up in the land of the dead himself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/cb14bc07c46c6882641e37e37ef1358bcf6d12b8.png[/img]


[h2]Spirit Rituals.[/h2]

A true test of a shaman’s ability can be found in the multiple Spirit Rituals across Kenzera. These gruelling rituals test your combat abilities with multiple waves of enemies for you to overcome. Sounds simple enough but you’ll have to show your mastery of the dance with the sun and moon masks to get past all foes, but upon completing each rank of the spirit ritual, you will be rewarded greatly! 

Completing the first round will grant Zau a permanent upgrade in which he gains an additional Spirit bar, which can be used for additional healing and unleashing devastating ultimate abilities like the Lunar Blast and Supernova!

Get past the second round and Zau is rewarded with an additional Trinket slot, which can allow you to have multiple trinkets equipped at once, allowing you to reap the additional benefits that they offer!

If you are able to overcome the third round of each Spirit Ritual, Zau is given a free additional skill point ready for you to use on the Skill tree to unlock the powers that it holds! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/102f3ba96df6e925d240786420b21aa7ec931f61.png[/img]

[h2]Unlock Trinkets[/h2]

The Shaman Trials may be notoriously challenging for you to jump, platform, dash and glide your way through, but upon completion of these you will get a reward in the form of an additional	 trinket! These trinkets all offer unique bonuses, like gaining more Ulogi (Experience points) from defeating enemies, do more damage by hitting enemies into the environment, do more damage when at full health and gain additional spirit by defeating foes, just as a few examples. 

This in combination with unlocking multiple Trinket slots from completing the Spirit Rituals can lead to Zau gaining some interesting and powerful bonus perks to help him in his quest to return his Baba!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/2a854921e9b248dd5cf193857f6dd3443941dd89.png[/img]

[h2]Save Spirit for healing[/h2]

As awesome as the Lunar Blast and Supernova are, using these Spirit Attacks consumes a lot of Zau’s Spirit, which is also a vital resource when it comes to Zau healing. This leads to you having to find a good balance between offence and defence. 

Due to this, it would be wise to ensure that you always try to keep at least 1 segment of Spirit available for when Zau is running low on health to keep him alive. 

This doesn’t mean you should never use the ultimate abilities at all, as they can be very useful to quickly dispatch multiple or stronger foes at once. Like all things in life. It comes down to finding a healthy balance! 

If you find you are running out of Spirit too often, we recommend you undertake the Spirit Rituals we mentioned earlier, as completing these can reward Zau with additional segments of Spirit that he can utilise! Zau can also find and equip unique Trinkets that increase the amount of Spirit he gains from damaging his foes, adding to the pool that can be used to healing or unleashing spirit attacks.

[h2]Shields[/h2]

Some enemies Zau encounters can be found to have shields making them tougher to deal with. These shields will protect their main health bar, and can recharge over time if you don’t eliminate them quickly enough. 

Sometimes, these shields can come with immunities to either the Sun or Moon mask attacks. If you find yourself face to face with an enemy with a blue shield, the best way to combat them would be with Moon mask attacks, as they are resistant to Sun mask attacks. Likewise, red shielded enemies are best combated with Sun Mask attacks to quickly deal with them. Make sure you are using the right Mask to deal with these enemy types effectively.

[h2]The Spear and the Stone[/h2]

In the first act of the game, Zau will gather special abilities from visiting the Shaman Shrines, like the water freezing Bamba’s Stone and the penetrating Akida’s Spear.

These both have great benefits for traversal, from freezing waterfalls for climbing up to new paths, or unlocking impassable doors, but also are extremely useful in combat too! 

Bamba’s Stone can be launched at enemies and freeze them in place, giving you the opportunity to score big hits on them while they are defenceless, or to give you a breather and regroup yourself in the heat of battle.

Akida’s Spear can also be weaponised by allowing you to throw it across long distances to strike your foes at range. It can also be upgraded in the skill tree to allow it to strike multiple enemies in one well aimed throw!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/be4d099f21fd33b43eae2bb6ccc23626bef717b8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reload[/h2]

The Moon Mask is great for ranged combat with its ability to fire 8 shots before having to recharge. This is a handy weapon in combat, but can be made even better by spending some skill points in the right places. You can invest skill points on the Moon Mask skill tree, taking Increased Light Charges, upgrade its firing capacity to 12 allowing you to get 50% more firepower before needing to reload. 

You can also unlock the Perfect Recharge skill which gives you an active reload, allowing you to reload faster if you can time it right. If you manage to nail the timing, you will also be given a temporary boost in your firepower as a reward! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/091356d83574489e28a09a183df34c39318a3004.png[/img]

[h2]Difficulty Options[/h2]

If you get really stuck, Tales of Kenzera: ZAU has 3 difficulty options available to you which you can switch between at any time. In the Pause menu, you can go into Settings and then Gameplay where you can switch from Relaxed, Standard and Challenging. 

These settings will modify aspects of the game to either reduce or increase the amount of damage you take, the amount of health enemies have as well as other gameplay tweaks to make it easier so you can fully experience Zau’s story with less stumbling blocks.

notes.title: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU PC specs and features
notes.content:
Get ready to embark on a poignant single-player story shaped by actor Abubakar Salim’s own experience with grief, discovering how love gives us the courage to press on after devastating loss. Wield powers from the Sun and the Moon to defeat restless spirits in rhythmic combat and become a worthy Nganga: a spiritual healer.

Planning to start your adventure on PC? Check out the minimum, recommended, and ultra PC specs in the image below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/c8687f6495aa96753c5174b3d6eda86e0d510e39.jpg[/img]


[b]Custom Graphics Settings[/b]

Hardware can vary tremendously from PC to PC, and we want to make sure players can tailor their gaming experience accordingly. Modify everything from textures to camera sway and tweak your frame rate or anti-aliasing method, your visual experience of Kenzera is entirely in your hands.

[b]Controller Support[/b]

Prefer to get hands-on with a controller rather than a keyboard and mouse? No problem, Tales of Kenzera: ZAU will support the Xbox controller.

[b]Ultrawide Monitor Support[/b]

For those who want to experience the beauty of Kenzera in all its glory, the game will support 21:9 UW. 

DLSS, FSR, and XeSS Support

Whether you're currently running an Nvidia, AMD, or Intel graphics card, we've got you covered with DLSS, FSR, and XeSS upscaling support.

[b]Pre-Order* Offer[/b]

There's still time to embark on your journey with special perks if you pre-order!
- Start with a 10% discount
- Wrap yourself in the Kalunga's Blessing visual effect variant
- Kickstart your adventure with 2 shaman points to unlock up to 2 skills in-game
- Discover more of our world with the “Soulshifters” digital companion comic

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316580/Tales_of_Kenzera_ZAU/

Join us and talk about all things Tales of Kenzera: ZAU on the official Surgent Studios [url=https://discord.com/invite/surgent]Discord[/url] Server

*Conditions and restrictions apply. See http://ea.com/games/tales-of-kenzera/zau/disclaimers for details.

notes.title: Soundoff: Best Moments in the ZAU Livestream with Neil Newbon
notes.content:
It's not every day that a vampire plays your demo.

The Tales of Kenzera: ZAU demo playthrough with Neil Newbon and Abubakar Salim went live on Monday, and the response has already been incredible! 

As a team we've watched the entire stream about 10000 times because we can't actually believe that Astarion has played our demo. 

Our favourite parts are:

[olist]
[*] When Neil discovers a colony of moles beneath a push block (we've fixed this bug by the way)
[*] When Abu accidentally admits that he viewed his entire life as a Pokemon game as a child
[*] When this pair of expressions happened:
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781414/4e9607fcb7573b4dc34eed48218189015a2e7db3.png[/img]

Ah, the duality of man.

Let us know your favourite moments in the comments! Our social team is editing down shortened versions and we'd love to know what you want to see on our [url=https://www.instagram.com/surgentstudios/?hl=en-gb]Instagram[/url].

- The Surgent team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739950/Tales_of_Kenzera_ZAU/
